content: I would like some more eyes on #38328. It introduces a new typeclass OrderSupSet which guarantees "correctness" of the sSup operation, in the sense that sSup s is always a LUB for s, if any LUB exists (and dually for OrderInfSet). This refactor has been discussed extensively in #general > Any infimum based version of `OmegaCompletePartialOrder`?, and I believe there is consensus towards this being a positive change.
Is the concern by Jireh here (and the following discussion) now resolved?
As explained in that PR, the eventual aim is for all the different flavors of complete lattices to either extend or imply this typeclass.
